text:
It’s beautiful to see you, Jake, & Noa transitioning into your new home. 
Thank you for sharing your journey with us Sissel. 
💖🌷

😭😭😭 you do realize we're always moving in and out with you? 

So as we leave a tear by sending off the beautiful past, we bring in plenty of smiles for the new chapter in your new home 😊😊😊

Cheers to all the incredible memories you'll continue to collect there 🎉🥂 it'll be worth every Won!
Ngl, almost teared up when you were saying goodbye to your old home. It’s a bittersweet reminder that all things come to an end and to appreciate what you have and how far you’ve come. 🌱💚
Sweet moment of Jake explaining to Noa he's half Saturnian and half Viking :planet-orange-purple-ring:so basically Hercules. Hilarious! 🤣
Be kind to yourself and allow things to take time! Wishing you Jake and Noa well in this new chapter 💕 Lycka till!
The conclusion that Noah is basically Hercules is insaneee 😂😂

The natural light that is coming in during the day in your new place is STUNNING 🥹 What a warm and beautiful home. I love the living space with the fireplace. Immediately think of the holidays and how cozy it’ll look decorated. Congratulations on the new home!! Thank you for sharing 🩷
Noa is Hercules! Love it! Leaving one home for another is always bittersweet, but so excited for all the new adventures awaiting you, Jake and Noa.

Kinda stupid, but when you were talking about organizing with a toddler and Noa going behind you and undoing everything. When you mentioned moving the couch my mind immediately pictured Noa moving it back and it made me laugh.
Your moving content is top tier. Congratulations on the new place, perfect for you and your precious family!

Sissel i dont know how you manage to make such heartfelt and honest vlogs while going through the stress of moving but this was one of my favorites! I am also at a moment in life that feels like a crossroads where everything is changing and I laughed and cried watching this ❤🥰 thanks for making great content.

I really LOVE this house. In the first 24 hours it immediately looked like a home because of all the little architectural details. The other home was modern but also at times looked a bit sterile because of all of the sleek lines and cool tones. This new (old lol) home makes it look like you are already in Europe!

i am SO early i've been WAITING for this i'm so excited 🤍
moving is always so bittersweet, moving to a different home that will tell it's own stories is so exciting,
but leaving a place that has it's own stories is so hard 🥹
Sissel I have been here for quite a couple years now and it's so beautiful to see all ur hardworking, you are doing amazing! All the best wishes for ur precious family <3
moving always make me realize how much I own. It's a good time to declutter!
I loooove moving vlogs. So excited to watch this because your vlogs are so well balanced and enjoyable. ❤
I love to hear you speak korean 🥺✨🫶🤍
my family is from the Caribbean and we also think that means a second one is on the way 👀 loved this vlog! The new space is lovely ✨
“Always, Always Hire Movers” - best advice I was ever given

Sissel, du er en kæmpe inspiration for hvor miljørigtig i er omkring tøj: selvom du er influncer og har mere end de fleste, er du og Jake super gode til at donerer det i ikke bruger! Noget ind og noget ud 💕
Og baby Noa snakker nu!!! ✨
Spændende tider 💕
Been here since the poster-selling days. I was still in college back then! Now I’m on my second year at work. I love you, Sissel 💛

So I'm going to Portugal in a week, I'll be there for a month, maybe two, and I've been really stressed about the whole travel process. Somehow watching you move house with all your stuff AND a whole baby to take care of made me feel better lol. I'm like, if Sissel can move all her stuff with a baby, then I can fly to Portugal with a suitcase. Can't wait to see more of your new home!
omg they packed your real banana tree the same way they packed my fake one!! 🤣🌴

You did it! Take it slow and have patience with Noa. My kid was three, when we moved. Crying for the old home is normal. Noa will settle in, don't worry. And you have to get used to it too. New smells, new sounds, new everything. Enjoy it. Can't wait for next weeks video.

I don’t mean to alarm you but my firstborn started doing the little handstand thing and wouldn’t you know it we were expecting our second 😂 .It’s also totally developmentally appropriate for them to be doing that movement at that age but we like to joke that she knew something that we didn’t at the time 🙊 Congratulations on this new chapter, may you create many happy memories in your new home ❤
“I like what you like,” is always the right answer. 😂 And yes, get yourself a ma like Jake.
I hope the rest of the unpacking goes well. Congratulations on your new home🎉
My little brother also had this rug as a toddler and it is iconic! And so much fun
23:23 90s kids like myself did have the best childhood ❤
looks so cozy already! I love the fireplace and the plants! Can't wait to see what it will all look like when you are done organising and decorating🥰
so exciting 🤍🤍 we love a good ikea visit
OMG!! IKEA always soothes my anxieties😄
Moving is way harder than everyone expects 😮 Love your new place ❤
20:18 EVERY SINGLE CHILD IN DK HAS HAD THAT CHAIR
Y’all are a beautiful couple!

We recently moved too, so I can totally relate to everything you’re going through! I was honestly shocked by how many clothes I have, reality really hit me hard 😅😂

But I’m so happy for you and your family in your new home. It looks absolutely beautiful! Congratulations again 🥰🌱🤍
One never realizes how much stuff they have until you move it. Good luck Sissel!

Sissel. Congratulations 🎉 I really loved this vlog. It is today that I know how to pronounce IKEA properly. I absolutely adore the jean/conductor skirt you wore shopping; perfect comfort look. I cannot wait to see your unpacked apartment.
Please show an overview of the house when you finish, maybe a time-lapse of organizing rooms 😅 it's satisfying to watch
So happy for you guys!
